_note: News items, newest first. The home page shows the first three. Each item needs date, title and summary; tag is one word shown as a label (Dues, Projects, Meetings, Rules, Events). For more than one paragraph add a body, with one quoted paragraph per line. Plain text only.

items.title: Fall dues invoices mailed
items.summary: Annual assessments were mailed September 12 and are due October 31. Pay online through the Portal or by check to the management office.

items.title: Entrance landscaping refresh begins September 22
items.summary: Crews will replace the plantings at the Glenridge Boulevard entrance over two weeks. Expect one lane closed weekday mornings.
body: Work runs Monday through Friday between 8:00 AM and 3:00 PM. The sidewalk on the north side stays open throughout.
The new beds are drought-tolerant perennials chosen to cut summer watering. Questions can be sent to the board through the Portal.

items.title: Board meeting: Wednesday, October 7, 7:00 PM
items.summary: Open to all homeowners. The agenda and the September minutes are posted under Documents one week before the meeting.

items.title: Street parking reminder
items.summary: Overnight street parking is limited to 48 hours in all sections. Guest parking questions can be sent through the Portal.

items.title: Pond aeration repair complete
items.summary: The fountain in the retention pond is running again after a pump replacement. Thank you for your patience during the outage.

items.title: Architectural requests: allow three weeks
items.summary: Fence, shed, and exterior paint requests are reviewed at each monthly meeting. Submit through the Portal with photos and a plot sketch.

items.title: Summer neighborhood cleanup, Saturday June 27
items.summary: Meet at the entrance at 9:00 AM. Bags and gloves provided. Yard-waste pickup follows on Monday.

items.title: June minutes posted
items.summary: Minutes from the June 2 board meeting are now in the Documents library under Meetings.
